title: Koszul tensor roof for a morphism on an affine open
statement: Let X be affine [def-pc-scheme], U a quasi-compact open, E' in D_QCoh(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category], and A perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex]. Fix a K-flat cochain complex P [def-pc-kflat-complex] and an isomorphism e_A:Q(P) ≅ A. For any morphism alpha:A|_U → E'|_U, there exist a K-flat complex J with Q(J) perfect and a chain augmentation u:J → O_X[0]. Put B=Q(Tot(P tensor J)) and beta=Q(id_P tensor u) followed by the right unitor and e_A. Then there exist gamma:B → E' and b_U:B|_U ≅ A|_U with b_U.hom=beta|_U and alpha=b_U.inv followed by gamma|_U. Neither perfectness of B nor its support is asserted.

source.place: Tag 08EH, proof of Lemma 36.13.7, construction of the Koszul tensor and its two maps; Tag 06YD for K-flatness

proof.text: Set H=RHom(A,E'). Perfect-source RHom quasi-coherence gives H in D_QCoh(X), without a bound on E'.
Apply tensor_roof_transposition to the fixed P,hP,e_A and obtain e. Set s=e inverse applied to α, so e(s)=α.
Apply affine_koszul_section_roof to H and s. This supplies J,hJ,hperfect,u,ξ with restricted augmentation invertible and R(Q(u)) followed by s = R(ξ).

Apply the supplied transposition property to J,u,ξ,s. Obtain γ with R(β) invertible and R(β) followed by α = R(γ). Set b_U=asIso(R(β)); its hom is definitionally R(β). Precompose the equality by its inverse and cancel inverse followed by hom. This proves α=b_U inverse followed by R(γ), and the witnesses give the original conclusion.

theorem exists_affine_perfect_tensor_roof
    (X : Scheme.{uX}) [IsAffine X] (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsCompact (U : Set X))
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wD} (SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{wD} (SheafOfModules.{uX} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wD} (SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    (E' : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X) (A : schemeDerivedCategory X) (hA : IsPerfect X A)
    (α : ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{uX} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U) ⋙
          Equivalence.functor
            (C := SheafOfModules.{uX} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
            (D := SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
            (Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory.obj A ⟶
        ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{uX} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U) ⋙
          Equivalence.functor
            (C := SheafOfModules.{uX} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
            (D := SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
            (Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory.obj E'.obj)
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (hP : CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := X.sheaf) P)
    (eA : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ≅ A) :
    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory X.sheaf
    letI := (SheafOfModules.tensorClosed X.sheaf).1.some
    ∃ J : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ,
      CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := X.sheaf) J ∧ IsPerfect X (DerivedCategory.Q.obj J) ∧
      ∃ u : J ⟶ HomologicalComplex.tensorUnit
          (SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ),
        let B := DerivedCategory.Q.obj (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor P J (curriedTensor _))
        let β : B ⟶ A := DerivedCategory.Q.map
          (HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorMap (𝟙 P) u (curriedTensor _) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ≫
          DerivedCategory.Q.map (HomologicalComplex.rightUnitor P).hom ≫ eA.hom
        let R := ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{uX} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U) ⋙
          Equivalence.functor
            (C := SheafOfModules.{uX} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
            (D := SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
            (Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory
        ∃ (γ : B ⟶ E'.obj) (bU : R.obj B ≅ R.obj A),
          bU.hom = R.map β ∧ α = bU.inv ≫ R.map γ
